title: Theo's Fund Averaged 10%. He Lost Money 😂
description:
Theo adds up his fund's yearly returns, gets an average of 10% a year and announces that his $10,000 is now $12,100. Nora opens the statement: $9,600. Year one was up 60% to $16,000. Year two was down 40% to $9,600. He made $6,000, then lost $6,400, because the drop came off a bigger pile.

The average of the percentages went up while the money went down. The compound return is what your balance actually did: about -2% a year here.

Do you check your dollars or your percentages? Tell us below 👇

Follow for more numbers that change how you spend.

⚠️ Illustration with fictional characters and a made-up fund: $10,000, +60% then -40%, no fees, taxes or dividends. Not a prediction of any investment's returns. This is not financial advice.
